instruction: [as @FrontendEngineer] This has real bugs. `backdropRef.current?.current` doesn't compile — `current` isn't a property of a DOM element, that's a typo. And `triggerRef` is never actually attached to the "Open Accessible Modal" button in `App`, so `triggerRef.current` is always null and focus-restore silently does nothing. Also you use `React.useState` and JSX without importing `React`. Fix these — give me the corrected version, not a rewrite of the whole thing.
